title: Phantom Warner
description: Tells you when phantoms will spawn. Displays a clean countdown in your action bar before they attack.
body:
# Phantom Warner
Phantom Warner is a simple mod that tells you when phantoms are coming. It tracks how long you are awake and shows a clean countdown on your screen.

With this mod, you don't need to guess anymore. The messages appear right above your hotbar, so your chat stays clean.

![Showcase 2700x speed](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/53fc5c218650dc9679a1b66106e24e57b228b3b1.gif)

### Main features:
**Countdown:** Shows warnings on your screen starting 30 minutes before phantoms spawn.

**Sounds:** Plays a short sound with every message so you don't miss it.

**Server-side:** Only needs to be installed on the server. Players don't need the mod on their own PC.

**No Reset:** If you leave the world, your timer just pauses. It will not reset to 0.

**Smart Sleep:** The timer resets instantly when you sleep in a bed. In Creative Mode, you see the messages but phantoms cannot spawn.

**Lag-free:** Very small mod, no lag for your server.

_**Installation and compatibility:**_
Built for Fabric, compatible with Minecraft 26.1.2. Just drop the jar into your mods folder!
